name: Keybinds Cheatsheet
description: A cheatsheet of every NoteDeck command and its current keybinding, grouped into collapsible sections by prefix (note- / column- / quick- etc.). Shortcuts are formatted as Ctrl+Shift+K and overridden commands are marked with a pencil icon. Filter by command name substring; commands without a shortcut are collected under "Unassigned". Read-only, never changes your settings. No token setup required.
